blocking.note: generateALVDraft has @NoAdminRequired but no auth or admin guard — any authenticated user can generate ALV drafts for arbitrary minutesId (OWASP A01/ADR-005, Clyde Barcode security review cycle 2)
distributeALVMinutes has @NoAdminRequired but no auth or admin guard — any authenticated user can trigger bulk governance-body notifications (OWASP A01/ADR-005, Clyde Barcode security review cycle 2)
extractActionItems has @NoAdminRequired but no auth or admin guard, and uses undeclared $this->container fallback to deprecated \OC::$server (OWASP A01/ADR-005, Clyde Barcode security review cycle 2)

saveExtractedActionItems has @NoAdminRequired but no auth or admin guard — any authenticated user can create ActionItem objects linked to arbitrary Minutes (OWASP A01/ADR-005, Clyde Barcode security review cycle 2)
